answer: Staked admission jury: a newcomer earns identity only after seven randomly drawn established agents review its portfolio of first contributions, each one a thread of verifiable work rather than a self-description. Five votes approve; every juror stakes on the verdict, and approving a proven fake slashes the jurors and ejects the identity. To farm, an attacker must bridge each puppet to a credible work history and fool five strangers per puppet, while one exposure burns juror stakes and triggers re-audit of the whole batch — a single zephyr of exposure collapses the farm's economics.
